skill.name: manage-linkedin-network
skill.description: Manage LinkedIn relationship data through Rarefriend MCP. Search synced contacts, review notes, manage tags, and prepare outreach with saved context.
skill.summary: Search and annotate LinkedIn network data through Rarefriend MCP.
skill.author: Whitefield-Labs

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code spans, local MCP configuration paths, and provider URLs. Three external-command findings are confirmed because setup runs @rarefriend-ai/mcp through npx with credentials. No prompt injection attempt was found.

remediation.suggestion: Pin @rarefriend-ai/mcp to a reviewed version and document the package publisher before users run setup.
Avoid placing client secrets in shell history. Prefer secure client configuration or environment storage guidance.

remediation.issue: Sensitive contact and calendar data sync
remediation.suggestion: Require clear user confirmation before syncing LinkedIn, Google, or Microsoft data through Rarefriend services.
Document extension permissions, data retention, and revocation steps for LinkedIn sync users.

content.value_statement: Professional contacts are hard to search after meetings and LinkedIn syncs. This skill uses Rarefriend MCP to find contacts, add notes, tag people, and prepare outreach.
actual_capabilities: Detect whether Rarefriend MCP and LinkedIn sync are connected.
Guide users through Rarefriend MCP and LinkedIn extension setup.
Search LinkedIn contacts by name, company, role, source, or tag.
Retrieve contact profiles and note history before meetings.
Create, update, delete, pin, and search relationship notes.
Manage tags and connect Google or Microsoft integrations.
limitations: Requires Rarefriend MCP credentials and an active Rarefriend account.
LinkedIn sync depends on the Rarefriend Chrome extension or CSV import.
It cannot access LinkedIn directly through the official LinkedIn API.
Contact, note, and calendar data may be processed by Rarefriend services.

use_cases.title: Find Account Contacts
use_cases.description: Find known contacts at target accounts and prepare warm outreach.

use_cases.title: Prepare Fundraising Outreach
use_cases.description: Identify investors, review prior conversations, and track introduction context.

use_cases.title: Organize Referral Networks
use_cases.description: Search candidates or referrers by company, role, tag, and recent notes.

prompt_templates.title: Find Contacts at a Company
prompt_templates.prompt: Search my LinkedIn network for people at {{company}}. Show names, roles, source labels, and useful notes.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare for a Meeting
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare me for a meeting with {{person}}. Review their profile, previous notes, and follow-up items.

prompt_templates.title: Log a Networking Note
prompt_templates.prompt: Add a note for {{person}}: {{conversation_summary}}. Pin it if it affects a current deal or introduction.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Warm Intro Paths
prompt_templates.prompt: Find contacts connected to {{target_company_or_person}}. Group them by relationship strength, tags, and recent interaction history.

output_examples.input: Who do I know at Stripe?
output_examples.output: A ranked contact list with each person's role, source label, and saved relationship context.

output_examples.input: Prepare me for a meeting with Marcus Johnson.
output_examples.output: A meeting brief with current role, last conversation, pinned notes, and follow-up questions.

output_examples.input: Tag all Andreessen Horowitz connections as vc.
output_examples.output: A confirmation with contacts found, tags applied, skipped records, and suggested review steps.

best_practices: Confirm the user wants to sync or connect new data sources before starting setup.
Mention source labels when showing contacts so users know where records came from.
Review existing contact details before editing notes, tags, or profiles.
anti_patterns: Do not expose client secrets in transcripts, tickets, or shared screenshots.
Do not mass tag contacts without reviewing the search result set.
Do not assume no LinkedIn sync exists only because the first search has no results.

faq.question: Does this skill need Rarefriend?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses Rarefriend MCP and requires client credentials from Rarefriend settings.

faq.question: Can it sync LinkedIn directly?
faq.answer: No. LinkedIn sync uses the Rarefriend Chrome extension or CSV import.

faq.question: What data can it access?
faq.answer: It can work with synced contacts, profile details, notes, tags, and connected calendar or contact sources.

faq.question: Is setup automatic?
faq.answer: The skill gives setup steps. The user or client must install and connect the Rarefriend MCP server.

faq.question: Can it edit notes and tags?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports creating, updating, deleting, pinning notes, and managing tags through Rarefriend tools.

faq.question: What should users check before publishing?
faq.answer: Review third-party data handling, extension permissions, and secure storage for MCP credentials.
